$comment: Generated from JobResult by `magus-utils jobschema`. DO NOT EDIT; run `magus run job-generate .`.
title: magus job result
description: JobResult is the result a holder files for a job.

api_version.description: Version is the format this record is written in. A reader refuses any other, so no magus acts on a record it cannot read.

requires.description: Requires names the features a reader must implement to act on this record at all. A reader lacking one treats the record as read-only; the records around it stay usable. Set only for content an older reader would act on wrongly, never for an added field it can ignore.

unrun.description: Unrun is the environment cause that kept the check from running, as on [VerificationEvidence].
Unrun is the cause that kept the goal's run from running in this environment. It files a failed attempt: `job wait` fails it.

follow_ups.description: FollowUps is work the holder explicitly leaves for later. Each item stands until the job's Deferred answers it.

observed_generation.description: ObservedGeneration is the job's Generation when the result was filed, stamped by the store rather than taken from the holder.
